e.title: Prompt Engineering
e.summary: 提示词模式库：few-shot/思维链/结构化输出等实战技巧
e.body: 提示词工程 skill（agentic-awesome-skills 收录）系统整理 few-shot、思维链、结构化输出等模式，用于改进提示与调试 agent 行为。对培训课：是「提示词」模块的现成教材；对本站萃取流程：你的 gen-*.cjs 与 IFA 去主观化规则本质上就是提示词工程实践，可对照升级。适用模型见 [[deepseek]]、[[gemini]]，agent 场景关联 [[openclaw]]。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：SKILL.md 内容已读（few-shot/优化技巧），未实测
e.summary_en: Prompt pattern library: few-shot / chain-of-thought / structured output techniques
e.summary_hk: 提示詞模式庫：few-shot/思維鏈/結構化輸出等實戰技巧
e.body_en: The prompt-engineering skill (curated in agentic-awesome-skills) systematically covers few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output and other patterns for improving prompts and debugging agent behavior. For training sessions: ready-made material for a prompting module. For this site's extraction flow: your gen-*.cjs scripts and the IFA de-subjectivization rules are essentially prompt-engineering practice — worth upgrading against these patterns. See [[deepseek]] and [[gemini]] for models, and [[openclaw]] for agent scenarios.
e.body_hk: 提示詞工程 skill（agentic-awesome-skills 收錄）系統整理 few-shot、思維鏈、結構化輸出等模式，用於改進提示與調試 agent 行為。對培訓課：是「提示詞」模塊的現成教材；對本站萃取流程：你的 gen-*.cjs 與 IFA 去主觀化規則本質上就是提示詞工程實踐，可對照升級。適用模型見 [[deepseek]]、[[gemini]]，agent 場景關聯 [[openclaw]]。
